files.content: import gzip import json import unittest from solution import decode_contacts class ContactsGzipUnicodeTests(unittest.TestCase): def test_malformed_deflate_counts_one_error(self): bad = bytes.fromhex('1f8b08000000000000ff07') + b'\x00' * 8 self.assertEqual(decode_contacts([bad]), {'anchors': [], 'errors': 1}) def test_unicode_separator_inside_json_string_is_not_ndjson_delimiter(self): raw = json.dumps({'label': 'a\u2028b', 'target': '/x'}, ensure_ascii=False) packed = gzip.compress(raw.encode('utf-8'), mtime=0) self.assertEqual(decode_contacts([packed]), {'anchors': ['a\u2028b'], 'errors': 0}) if __name__ == '__main__': unittest.main()
